title: Based Trivia
tagline: A live trivia game built using ThirdWeb on Optimism, Base, Mode and Livepeer. (HQ Trivia for Web3))
description:
A live trivia game built using ThirdWeb on Optimism, Base, Mode and Livepeer. (HQ Trivia for Web3))

Based trivia allows users to participate in weekly live, trivia games in which they could win or split prize money.  Not only creating a space for the crypto curious to learn about the blockchain in a fun, engaging and potentially rewarding way, but it also makes them interact with OP, Base and Mode as they learn in real time because Based Trivia is built completely on the blockchain with answers being minted to the blockchain as tokens.
how_its_made:
This project was built using 
- ThirdWeb 
on 
- Optimism, 
- Base, 
- Mode 
and 
- Livepeer

The token contracts are written as ERC-1155 NFTs written in Solidity and deployed using Third Web.

We coded the project frontend suing Next JS and Tail Wind 

We really have on Account Abstraction to allow easy sign in, multichain interaction and gasless transactions. 

The live streaming of the trivia event is built on Livepeer.
